What is one dish I should try there?

Try **pastéis de nata**, the creamy custard tarts with flaky, caramelized pastry. Eat them warm with a dusting of cinnamon, ideally at Pastéis de Belém or a local café. If you want something savory, grilled sardines are another classic.
